referenceStructure: Closed hollow upper enclosure, receiving opening with interior wall contours and exterior shell; opening is not a solid disc. At +30mm the horizontal side offsets are approximately 2.5mm. Mouth/thread zones vary; not used as calibrated dimensions.

mapping.floorMm: new closed blind floors 2.5–3.0mm; deliberately not claimed source floor
mapping.closure: receiving enclosure with recessed closing disk; original topology, no copied screw thread
mapping.magnetSeats: new 6mm diameter × 3mm magnets with independent .15–.4mm diametrical and .1–.3mm axial proposed clearances
mapping.axle: new 3mm M3 gauge with .2–.5mm diametrical allowance
mapping.cover: new 1–1.4mm disk with .15–.4mm diametrical adhesive clearance
mapping.personalization: local safe floor Boolean engraving .4–.6mm, >=1.9mm backing
mapping.grip: New smooth/8-rib tactile variants and .39mm-deep outer orientation witnesses; do not claim exact copied source profile

differences: Two facing sealed carriers form a manually turned magnetic alignment fidget instead of a storage enclosure. Rounded, hexagonal or octagonal grips; 4/6/8 paired wells, per-part plate and coupon. All geometry is an original parametric solid reconstruction. No source organic exterior or thread profile is reused.
